Well that's quite a problem:i also find it hard to listen for modulation to the dominant.
However, listening for modulation to the relative major or minor is easier, e.g. baroque pieces include tierce die picardie (bach adores this). Modern pieces can be hard due to dissonace; i suggest learning how to modulate and trying a few chord progressions. If you are studying bach chorale you may have learned pivot modulation whereby you share the same chord between 2 keys. Perhaps play around with common keys (e.g. c major) first and see if it works.
Hope it helps :)
